text: Exhibition Place employee(s) recognized by the Board for recent outstanding accomplishment: 1. 2022 United Way City of Toronto Campaign Each year in an effort to build a better city, the City of Toronto Public Service Staff, along with all Agencies, Boards, and Commissions participate in the annual city-wide fundraising program in support of United Way Toronto and York Regions. Ms. Catherine de Nobriga is recognized for her dedication and hard work managing the 2022 United Way City of Toronto Campaign for Exhibition Place. This year, Exhibition Place raised a grand total of $2,786.30 for the United Way of Toronto Campaign. In 2022 we focused our efforts on a few of the City Programs - Employee Pledge, BINGO, and the Cash Raffle, along with our events that have been successful in the past Ghost Walks, Old Technology Sales, and an online auction. Over the last 18 years Exhibition Place…
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Applauded and extended congratulations to Ms. Catherine de Nobriga for her outstanding efforts on the 2022 United Way City of Toronto Campaign.
